backend/main.mo: Motoko actor that stores contact form submissions in a map, with a submitMessage function that validates required fields and assigns unique IDs with timestamps.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two completed features: updating the page title to 'Friends AC Services' and updating the Hero component headline with accent color styling.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend files describing the AC services website components, styling, and functionality.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining CSS custom properties for light and dark themes with warm orange/amber accents and blue-gray primary colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with page title 'Friends AC Services' and root div for React mounting.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that assembles the full page layout with Hero, Services, About, ContactForm, Footer sections and toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/About.tsx: About section displaying four statistics cards (experience, customers, certifications, support) and a commitment statement highlighting company credibility.
frontend/src/components/ContactForm.tsx: Contact form with name, phone, email, service type selector, and message fields, plus three contact info cards showing phone, email, and location details.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer with company info, contact details, business hours, social media links (Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, LinkedIn), and attribution with UTM tracking.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Hero section with background image overlay, 'Friends AC Services' headline with accent-colored text, service description, and two call-to-action buttons that scroll to contact form.
frontend/src/components/Services.tsx: Services section displaying four AC service cards (Installation, Repair, Maintenance, Emergency Service) in a responsive grid with icons and descriptions.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that manages the backend actor instance using React Query, creating authenticated or anonymous actors based on Internet Identity state and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useContactForm.ts: React hook that handles contact form submission via the backend actor, converting form data to the required format with nanosecond timestamps and displaying toast notifications for success/error states.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a professional color scheme using OKLCH color space, featuring warm orange accents and deep blue-gray primary colors for both light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client and Internet Identity provider, then renders the root App component.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending the default theme with custom colors mapped to CSS variables, Inter font family, custom border radius values, shadows, and animation keyframes for accordion components.
project_state.json: Project state tracking document showing completed features for an AC services website including hero section, services listing, contact form, about section, footer, and branding updates for 'Friends AC Services'.
